metadata.name: en_es_ptbr_precision_ipa_vocab
metadata.description: Precision-prioritized shared IPA-like CTC phoneme vocabulary for English, Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese hotword adaptation.
metadata.id_assignment: Token IDs are assigned by array index in the tokens list.
metadata.design_goal: Improve Qwen3-ASR hotword and near-pronunciation recall for English, Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. Output size is a consequence of the selected phone inventory, not the primary objective.

primary_sources.source: Montreal Forced Aligner English (US) MFA dictionary v2.0.0
Montreal Forced Aligner Spanish (Latin America) MFA dictionary v2.0.0
Montreal Forced Aligner Portuguese (Brazil) MFA dictionary v2.0.0

method_references.name: Phonemic and Graphemic Multilingual CTC Based Speech Recognition
method_references.role: Uses a multilingual global phone set for CTC-style multilingual ASR.

method_references.name: WHISTLE
method_references.role: Uses G2P-generated IPA phoneme labels and a multilingual phoneme alphabet built from language inventories.

method_references.name: Kokoro/Misaki
method_references.role: Engineering reference that language-specific G2P frontends can feed a shared IPA-like token space, while not being used as the authoritative CTC inventory.

merge_policy.language_and_dialect_location: Sample metadata and hotword registry fields, not token names.
merge_policy.construction: Take the union of the three MFA phone inventories after project normalization; identical phone symbols share one CTC ID.
merge_policy.precision_policy: Do not collapse phones that may separate hotwords or near-pronunciation negatives in English, Spanish, or Brazilian Portuguese.

normalization_policy.stress_marks: Do not include lexical stress marks in CTC targets.
normalization_policy.tone_marks: Do not include tone marks; target languages are English, Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.
normalization_policy.mfa_diphthong_style: Use MFA glide notation such as aj, aw, ej, ow, and ɔj.
normalization_policy.nasal_vowels: Keep Brazilian Portuguese nasal vowels and nasal glides because they are important for hotword discrimination.
normalization_policy.narrow_allophones: Keep MFA phone symbols in this v0.2 precision candidate unless later data shows they are too sparse or harmful.
normalization_policy.oov_policy: Map unseen G2P phones to <unk> only after manual review; recurring OOV phones should trigger a vocabulary review.

review_notes.spanish_spain_not_primary: The v0.2 table targets Latin American Spanish. The token θ is present because it is in English MFA; Spain-specific Spanish coverage should be evaluated separately before changing language scope.
review_notes.training_follow_up: After phonemizing the real training set and FLEURS hotword registry, compute per-token counts. Tokens with extremely low support should be reviewed before final training.
